name: tinto-batch-book-hotel-rooms
description: Requesting a new seasonal hotel room hold, recording the hotel's reply, or converting a confirmed block into a sold tour's actual booking (including bridging the net sellable rooms into Room Blocks), writing to the production base's Hotel Room Inventory, Room Blocks, and Supplier Booking Lead Times tables. A standalone plugin, open to whoever manages hotel blocks (typically Tamara or Nélia), separate from the restricted tinto-logistics daily-cycle plugin.
